# Dudley Development

> Dudley Development, LLC builds and publishes iPhone games, conversation cards, plain-language learning apps, and everyday utilities. The live catalog includes Table Talk: Conversation Cards, EconByte: Daily Economics, Last Human: Dodge the Bots, Packed Yet? Trip Checklist, Powell Prowl: Rate Chase, and VibeRater Social. Each app page states its release status, price model, account requirement, offline behavior, and privacy boundary.

## Apps

- [Table Talk: Conversation Cards](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/table-talk/): Table Talk is a free iPhone app of conversation-starter cards for dinner tables, first dates, and friend groups: 420 prompts plus a Would You Rather deck, with no account needed. Works offline. Live on the App Store. iOS 16.6 or later. No account or sign-up required. All prompts, bookmarks, and the daily card work offline. The six main decks and Would You Rather are free. Three prompt packs, a bundle, the Daily Featured Archive and Remove Ads are optional one-time purchases. No subscription. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780714565?pt=128970277&ct=tt-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [EconByte: Daily Economics](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/econbyte/): EconByte is a free iPhone app that explains inflation, interest rates, GDP, trade and more in bite-sized daily cards, in plain language, sourced to named institutions like the Federal Reserve and the Bureau of Labor Statistics. Live on the App Store. iOS 16.6 or later. No account or sign-up required. All cards, streaks, and bookmarks work offline. Inflation and Interest Rates are free. Topic packs, Unlock All Topics, and Remove Ads are one-time purchases at in-app prices. EconByte Pro is an optional subscription. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780714383?pt=128970277&ct=eb-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [Last Human: Dodge the Bots](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/last-human/): Last Human is a satirical top-down arcade dodge game where you're the last remaining office worker in an AI-automated workplace. Dodge the bots before they optimize your desk. Live on the App Store. iOS 16.6 or later. No account required. Playable offline after download. Free to download; optional one-time Remove Ads purchase at the price shown in the app. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/last-human-dodge-the-bots/id6808782611?pt=128970277&ct=lh-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [Packed Yet? Trip Checklist](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/packed-yet/): Packed Yet? is a fast, private packing checklist for iPhone. Start from a practical trip template, tailor the list, check items off, and reuse the trip next time, with no account and no cloud setup. Live on the App Store. iOS 17.0 or later. No account required. Trip planning and packing work offline; internet is only needed for ads, purchases, and support links. Free with restrained ads; a $2.99 one-time purchase removes advertising. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6814598931?pt=128970277&ct=py-web-llms&mt=8).
- [Powell Prowl: Rate Chase](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/monetary-policy-independence-day/): Powell Prowl: Rate Chase is a free satirical iPhone mini-game collection. Play as El Pres chasing Le Chair through 60 hand-tuned levels and 15 distinct game types, including tag, sniper, canoe race and wrestle, for a rate-cut memo. Live on the App Store. iOS 16.6 or later. No Dudley account required; Game Center is optional for leaderboards. Core play and progress work without a Dudley server. Free to download; a $0.99 one-time purchase removes ads. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6775539250?pt=128970277&ct=pp-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).
- [VibeRater Social](https://dudleyapps.com/apps/vibe-rater/): A playful social app for iPhone. Rate a photo, then keep it private, share it with your Squad, or post it to Vibes. Live on the App Store. iOS 17 or later. An account supports profiles, posts, follows, messages and deletion controls. The privacy policy lists what the account stores. Rating, posting, feeds, and social features require a network connection. Free to download with optional fixed-price Remove Ads, VibeBoost, and VibeToken purchases. [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/viberater-social/id6780704282?pt=128970277&ct=vr-web-llms-sep26-v1&mt=8).

## Recent articles

The Dudley Blog publishes sourced articles on App Store mechanics, iPhone privacy and AI media. Full index: https://dudleyapps.com/blog/ (RSS: https://dudleyapps.com/blog/rss.xml).

- [What Does Offline-First Mean in an iPhone App?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-does-offline-first-mean-iphone-app/): Offline-first means an app can do its main job without a live internet connection. It is useful, but it is not the same thing as no data collection.
- [What Does Not Enough Ratings Mean on the App Store?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-does-not-enough-ratings-mean-app-store/): Not enough ratings means Apple is not displaying a public ratings overview for the app in that storefront yet. It does not prove an app has no users, no downloads, or low quality.
- [What Does Ready for Distribution Mean in App Store Connect?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-does-ready-for-distribution-mean-app-store-connect/): Ready for Distribution means Apple has accepted the app version and it can be distributed, but it does not prove downloads, usage, revenue, or crash-free performance.
- [What Does No Account Required Mean in an iPhone App?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-does-no-account-required-mean-iphone-app/): No account required usually means you can use the app without signing in. It does not automatically mean no data, no ads, no purchases, or no privacy label.
- [What Does Not Enough Data Mean in App Store Connect?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-does-not-enough-data-mean-app-store-connect/): Not Enough Data usually means App Store Connect does not have enough eligible data to show a metric. It is not the same as zero installs, zero usage, or zero revenue.
- [What Are First-Time Downloads in App Store Connect?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-are-first-time-downloads-app-store/): First-Time Downloads show new App Store downloads, but they are not the same as active users, retention, revenue, or product-market fit.
- [What Is Age Assurance in Apps?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-is-age-assurance-in-apps/): Age assurance is how an app or app store estimates, checks, or receives a user's age range so it can apply age-appropriate rules.
- [Does Google Photos Ask Photos Use Your Photos for AI Training?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/does-google-photos-ask-photos-use-your-photos-for-ai-training/): Google says Gemini features in Google Photos do not use your personal Photos data for ads or to train generative AI models outside Google Photos.
- [What Are Content Credentials on AI Photos?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-are-content-credentials-ai-photos/): Content Credentials are provenance metadata that can show how a photo was created or edited.
- [Can You Remove the Gemini AI Watermark?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-you-remove-gemini-ai-watermark/): Gemini now lets some users turn off visible watermarks on AI-generated media.
- [What Is Nano Banana AI?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/what-is-nano-banana-ai/): Nano Banana is Google's nickname for Gemini image generation and editing models.
- [Can iPhone Apps Tell When You Screen Record?](https://dudleyapps.com/blog/can-iphone-apps-tell-when-you-screen-record/): An iPhone app can often tell when its own screen is being recorded or mirrored, but that does not mean it can read the recording file or browse your old screen recordings.

## About

Dudley Development is the public-facing studio name of Dudley Development, LLC. [Nick Santulli](https://dudleyapps.com/about/nick-santulli/) is the founder of Dudley Development. Every app Dudley has published on the App Store is free to download; optional purchases are described on each app page. Client work built for other brands is identified as client work and is not part of the Dudley catalog. Account needs, cloud storage, analytics, advertising, and tracking behavior vary by app and are disclosed in each app's privacy policy. Dudley Development does not sell personal information.
